sentences.en: The failure was detected in time, thereby preventing a disaster.
sentences.zh: 及时发现了失败，因此避免了一场灾难。

sentences.en: He is usually straightforward and sincere and thereby gains the confidence of those who meet him.
sentences.zh: 他通常坦率真诚，从而赢得了与他接触的人的信任。

sentences.en: Over time, wave action undercuts sea cliffs and thereby causes them to fall into the ocean.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，海浪的作用侵蚀了海崖底部，从而使它们坠入大海。

senses.zh: 从而，因此；在那附近；在那方面
